  How to Submit Public Comment

  Members of the Public who wish to submit public comment may do so using one of
  the following methods. Public comment is limited to the time allotted.

  In-Person: Complete a Speaker Card indicating the agenda item number and submit it to
  the City Clerk prior to the meeting. Speakers shall be limited to three (3) minutes per person
  per item. At the Mayor’s discretion, the time limit may be shortened to allow all speakers to
  address the City Council. Please note that interactions between the City Council, City
  staff, and the public during meetings are subject to the City’s Rules of Decorum.

  Website: Electronic submission of Public Comment is available via the online public
  comment form at Public Comment. Public Comment submitted electronically by
  4:00 P.M. on the meeting day will be forwarded to the City Council before the
  meeting for their consideration, but will not be read during the meeting. Comments
  submitted after 4:00 P.M. will be forwarded to Council but may not be received
  before the meeting.

  Watch the Meeting Online

  Live broadcasts of the meetings are available using the following link:

MINUTES OF FEBRUARY 3, 2026
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Menchaca called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at
  5:40 P.M. on Tuesday, February 3, 2026, in City Hall, Conference Room A, 425 S. Mission
  Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Tony Ding, Jorge Herrera Avila, John Wu, Vice Mayor
  Eric Chan, and Mayor Denise Menchaca.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, City Attorney Keith
  Lemieux, Chief City Clerk Sharon Clark, and Community
  Development Director David Sanchez.

  1. CLOSED SESSION

I  A. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  INITIATION OF LITIGATION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION
  54956.9 [C]: TWO CASES

  Case: 904 S. Del Mar Avenue, San Gabriel; property owners Yan Yu, as Trustee of
  the Yan Yu Trust and Jia Hu Cong.
  Case: 1521 Manley Drive, San Gabriel; property owner Yan Yu, Trustee of the Yan
  Yu Trust.

  The City Council unanimously gave authorization for initiation of litigation to abate
  public nuisance for both cases.

  2. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:13 P.M.
